_description: 6 pre-built aviation loyalty rule patterns. Each entry describes the pattern name, the Neo block type it maps to, the placeholders it consumes, and a ready-to-paste code snippet.

patterns.name: Alias Matcher (FFN Validation)
patterns.description: Calls an internal Neo DAG to resolve a loyalty-ID (FFN/frequent-flyer number) against the Capillary customer alias store. Separates valid aliases from failures before accrual.
patterns.notes: Requires pre-call preparation block to build per-transaction query params (FFN, first name, last name).

patterns.name: Duplicate PNR Guard
patterns.description: Queries MongoDB UtilisedPNR collection using a composite PNR key (pnr+name+origin+dest+date) to detect already-processed PNRs before calling the transaction API.

patterns.name: Staff Travel Filter
patterns.description: Schema-level and script-level filter that rejects PNRs from staff/duty-travel passengers based on class codes, pax types, and source org codes.
patterns.notes: Also add transaction_source filter with CODESHARE_SOURCES for codeshare marketed flights.

patterns.name: Fraud Email Alert
patterns.description: Event-driven block that reads fraud thresholds from Neo key-value store, queries UtilisedPNR for duplicate PNRs on the same departure date, and sends HTML email alerts for overlapping, multi-origin, and multi-destination patterns.
patterns.notes: Email body is HTML-table format. Reads to/cc/from from key-value store key {{FRAUD_CUSTOMER_EMAIL_CONFIG_KEY}} or {{FRAUD_TRANSACTION_EMAIL_CONFIG_KEY}} depending on event type.

patterns.name: Billing Date Lookback Window
patterns.description: Script block that rejects transactions whose billingDate is older than a configurable number of days. Returns error code 6005.
patterns.notes: Place this check inside the ValidationFailureBlock Script, after schema validation.

patterns.name: Boarding Status Gate
patterns.description: After alias validation, routes transactions based on boarding_status extended field. Status '2' proceeds to accrual; any other status is marked no-show, logged to Mongo, and returned without transaction add.
patterns.notes: No-show transactions update {{MONGO_PNR_TRANSACTIONS_COLLECTION}} flight_status to FLOWN and is_active to false without calling transaction/bulk.
